svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.8.1.5 Tactile Walking Surface Indicators
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.8.1.5 Tactile Walking Surface Indicators
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.8 STAIRS, RAMPS, LANDINGS, HANDRAILS AND GUARDS
Tactile attention indicators are installed in
At the top of flights of stairs that are
At drop-off edges with a change in elevation over
300 mm (11 13/16″) not protected by a guard
within dwelling units, and stairs and drop-off edges
serving not more than two dwelling units.
Stairs in open spaces, stairs from mezzanines, and
stairs not separated from the floor area by an
element such as a door or gate.
Drawn: an open stair to an upper floor with an unguarded edge. Strip size and dome pattern are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.8.1.5. (page 9-29), with Article 3.3.1.19. and Note A-3.3.1.19.(1).
